title: Mythical Network — Adaptive LAN Rewiring Plan
principle: Every swap gives new info. Re-plan at every 3rd step. The network is alive — it teaches us as we change it.

available_hardware.switches_on_shelf: Kevin has 1G, 2.5G, managed, and unmanaged switches — inventory needed
available_hardware.cables: Need to know: Cat5e? Cat6? Cat6a? Fiber patch cables?
available_hardware.sfp_modules: Need to know: what SFP+ modules available?

adaptive_steps.action: Get MikroTik password (webfig on :80) — see every physical port assignment
adaptive_steps.measures: port map, link speeds per port, SFP+ status

adaptive_steps.action: Wire eastGate eno1 (spare NIC) -> router lan2 (direct 1G backup path)
adaptive_steps.measures: latency to router via eno1 vs enp5s0, failover test

adaptive_steps.action: MEASURE — full latency sweep, compare to baseline
adaptive_steps.note: First re-plan point. Did the spare NIC path help? What changed?

adaptive_steps.action: Wire 2.5G switch inline for lower-speed gates (spore+graft+blue)
Wire ironGate spare NIC -> router lan3 (dual-home the GH Actions runner)

adaptive_steps.measures: all latencies, throughput, WiFi interference check
adaptive_steps.note: Second re-plan. Three new cables in. What does the network tell us?

adaptive_steps.action: Enable BLE mesh scanning on all 5 gates — proximity gossip protocol
adaptive_steps.measures: BLE RSSI between gates, phone detection range

adaptive_steps.action: Move graftGate M4 to House 2 via JetStream — plug into fiber side
adaptive_steps.measures: M4 latency from House 2, fiber utilization

adaptive_steps.action: MEASURE — full sweep with M4 on far side of fiber
adaptive_steps.measures: cross-house latency, BLE range between houses (probably too far)
adaptive_steps.note: Third re-plan. Organism now spans both houses. What synergies appear?

synergy_layers.copper_1g: RJ45 ethernet — reliable, every device has it
synergy_layers.copper_2_5g: 2.5GBASE-T — sporeGate native, some switches support it
synergy_layers.wifi_2_4ghz: Aperture Science — IoT, phones, broad coverage
synergy_layers.wifi_5ghz: Black Mesa — streaming, low latency, shorter range
synergy_layers.ble: 5 radios — proximity mesh, phone detection, room-level presence
synergy_layers.usb: SoloKey, ADB — physical ceremony, direct contact
synergy_layers.cellular: AT&T + eSIM — WAN backup via phones
synergy_layers.all_are_mesh: Every medium is a signal layer. Proximity is useful. 2-3 gates and IoT CAN talk to each other. More with each swap.
